text:
ria: Sales just asked to pull forward tenant routing and enterprise SSO into v1; they called it a renewal blocker.
sam: Clarify: enterprise SSO = OIDC + SCIM + audit exports?
maya: Yup. Public v1 is mid-Jul, sales wants early Jun. Tight.
jon: If we accelerate SSO, we must slide something. Analytics retention and promo UI are low-customer priority.
ria: Can we offer a scoped canary: OIDC + audit streaming first, SCIM as GA follow-up?
maya: That seems reasonable. OIDC + audit export is ~4w if we parallelize infra and QA. SCIM adds most of the test matrix.
sam: Legal SLA will need attention; that can block sign-off even if feature is ready.
jon: Infra plan: run canary in a single region, dedicated small pool, feature-flagged for 3 pilot tenants.
maya: Acceptance criteria draft: pilot logins working, audit events delivered to their SIEM, <1% auth error, rollback plan tested.ria: Action items: maya -> PRD for scoped canary by EOD; jon -> infra routing plan by Thurs; sam -> loop in legal for SLA language. I'll confirm canary acceptance with customer today.
ops-bot: Created ISSUE-7123 "sso-canary-scope" https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/ISSUE-7123
ria: Decision summary: deliver OIDC-canary early Jun (feature-flagged). Commit to SCIM GA in v1 (mid-Jul). Cuts: promo UI + extended retention -> v1.1. Risks: SLA negotiation and SCIM edge cases.
